'''Habeer Zignean''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Ord Mirit]], who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to avenge the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his father. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] under the callsign [[Green Five/Legends|Green Five]]<ref name="Star Wars Insider" />. He attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his ship.<ref name="TESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Habeer Zignean was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]]. Zignean's helmet prop was originally worn by [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']].<ref name="SWI 55">{{InsiderCite|55|Set Piece|Set Piece: Hoth Echo Base Main Hangar}}</ref> Zignean was portrayed by [[John Mogridge]].<ref name="STI">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back/john-mogridge-snowspeeder-pilot|text=JOHN MOGRIDGE (SNOWSPEEDER PILOT)-Interview|archivedate=20191207164406|nolive=1}}</ref>
